description: A sound for an edit by name ('the FAAAA sound'), by the moment ('bad news reaction') or by link (TikTok sound, meme-sound page, post, audio file): a durable mp3 and where it starts and lands. Named/described sounds come from what TikTok uses now; pick takes another candidate. A sound that does not exist yet is generate_sfx.

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

pick.description: candidate number from the previous list to take instead of the first

query.description: sound by name, moment or meaning, e.g. 'bad news reaction'

url.description: link to a TikTok sound, a post, a meme-sound page or an audio file

name: find_sound
title: Find a sound
